settings.tagline: Handmade with Love, One Stitch at a Time
settings.operatingHours: Monday – Friday: 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM | Saturday: 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM (By Appointment)
settings.aboutText: We are passionate about turning simple yarn into beautiful, handmade creations. Our mission is to create unique, high-quality knitting and crochet pieces with care, creativity, and love. We believe every stitch tells a story, and our goal is to bring warmth, comfort, and joy to every customer through handmade craftsmanship.

services.title: Handmade Clothing
services.description: Custom-fitted, beautifully styled handmade clothing tailored with premium wool, cotton, and organic yarns for cozy everyday elegance.
features: Choice of premium natural yarns & blends
Care instructions & extra matching yarn included

services.title: Baby & Kids Collection
services.description: Ultra-soft, gentle, hypoallergenic knitwear designed specifically for babies, toddlers, and growing little ones.
features: Baby booties, beanies, sweaters & heirloom blankets

services.title: Matching Family Sets
services.description: Coordinated handmade beanies, sweaters, and scarves for the entire family — ideal for holiday photo sessions and cozy winter outings.
features: Sized for infants, children, teens, and adults
Unified color palettes and matching stitch motifs
Durable comfort designed for active family memories
Custom pet matching bandanas or sweaters upon request

services.title: Custom Colors & Designs
services.description: Have a specific color scheme, stitch pattern, or Pinterest reference in mind? We bring your one-of-a-kind vision to life.
features: Made to exact size & proportion specifications

services.title: Knitting Repairs & Restoration
services.description: Expert restoration and repair for beloved heirloom knits, snagged garments, unraveling seams, and vintage handmade blankets.
features: Precise yarn matching and tension replication
Moth hole repairs, dropped stitch fixes & re-edging
Gentle steam blocking and conditioning finish

portfolio.title: Chunky Cable-Knit Wool Sweater
portfolio.description: An ultra-cozy, handcrafted cable-knit sweater made with 100% natural Peruvian Highland wool. Designed for warmth, relaxed modern drape, and heirloom longevity.
portfolio.materials: 100% Pure Highland Wool, Natural Oat Shade

portfolio.title: Heirloom Pastel Baby Beanie & Booties Set
portfolio.description: A gentle, hypoallergenic crochet gift set including a ribbed pompom beanie, cozy snug booties, and a matching miniature swaddle blanket for newborn photography.

portfolio.title: Coordinated Winter Family Beanie Set
portfolio.description: A matching set of 4 custom beanies for two parents and two toddlers featuring ribbed turn-up brims, removable faux-fur poms, and customized engraved leather tags.
portfolio.client: The Harrison Family Holiday Photo Shoot
portfolio.materials: Merino Wool Blend, Vegan Leather Tags

portfolio.title: Hand-Crocheted Textured Throw Blanket
portfolio.description: A generous textured waffle-stitch crochet blanket designed to add tactile warmth to any living room sofa or reading nook.

portfolio.title: Personalized Monogrammed Baby Blanket
portfolio.description: A delicate scalloped crochet blanket with custom hand-embroidered initials in subtle blush rose and ivory accents.
portfolio.materials: Extra-fine Merino Wool, Silk Ribbon Detailing

portfolio.title: Artisan Cable Infinity Scarf & Fingerless Mitts
portfolio.description: A rich honey-mustard cable knit infinity loop scarf with matching fingerless texting gloves, knit with seamless hand construction.
